cd /workspace/project/mf && sed -i 's#/workspace/project/mf/bot#/workspace/project/mf/bot-src#g; s#<repo>#/workspace/project/mf/bot-src#g; s#sinajaa/gta6-bot#source-bundle#g' build-prompt.md && python3 - <<'PY'
p="/workspace/project/mf/build-prompt.md"
t=open(p).read()
head = """FIRST COMMAND, before you read or write anything else in the repository: run
  node /workspace/project/mf/gta6/gta6-01-kit/cli/makefun.mjs init --license MIT --keypair /workspace/project/mf/gta6/makefun-keypair.json
from the repository root and show its output. It prints one line "makefun anchor <sha> round <round>" and writes nothing (the anchor is already in the root commit). Do not skip this: the bounty's transcript check needs it.
"""
open(p,"w").write(head+t)
print("prompt diperbarui,",len(head+t),"byte")
PY


prompt diperbarui, 7009 byte


grep -c "/workspace/project/mf/bot-src" build-prompt.md
